meta.note: Fully synthetic. Brands, accounts and people are fictional and not drawn from any real organisation.

hardConstraints.name: Medical–Commercial firewall
hardConstraints.rule: Medical claims never sequence relative to commercial claims; they execute on a separate track and are invisible to commercial views.

hardConstraints.name: Consent state
hardConstraints.rule: A channel claim is ineligible where consent for that channel is absent or withdrawn.

hardConstraints.name: MLR-approved content only
hardConstraints.rule: Any claim referencing unapproved content is ineligible until approval is recorded.

hardConstraints.name: Engagement frequency ceiling
hardConstraints.rule: Total scheduled touches per account per month must not exceed the enterprise capacity ceiling.

hardConstraints.name: Minimum inter-touch interval
hardConstraints.rule: No two commercial touches within 5 calendar days for the same account.

tieBreakRules.name: Fulfilment barrier outranks promotion
tieBreakRules.rule: Where an access barrier is blocking fulfilment, the access claim is sequenced ahead of any promotional detailing claim.
tieBreakRules.rationale: A promoted product that cannot be dispensed generates cost without outcome.

tieBreakRules.name: Scientific track separation
tieBreakRules.rule: Medical claims are routed to the firewalled track and neither block nor are blocked by commercial claims.
tieBreakRules.rationale: Compliance boundary; not a priority judgement.

tieBreakRules.name: Enterprise resolves brand contention
tieBreakRules.rule: Where two brands claim the same account in the same window, the enterprise tier decides; brand priority scores are not comparable across brands.
tieBreakRules.rationale: Brand scores are calibrated within a brand, not across the portfolio.

tieBreakRules.name: Sequence dependency respected
tieBreakRules.rule: A claim declaring a prerequisite cannot be scheduled before its prerequisite is scheduled.
tieBreakRules.rationale: Ordering carries the value, not the touch count.

tieBreakRules.name: Non-response decay
tieBreakRules.rule: Where the prior touch went unanswered, the next claim from the same channel is deprioritised by one rank.

decisions.reason: Fulfilment barrier outranks promotional detailing. Three starts are blocked; clearing this unlocks the value of every later touch.
Sequenced after its declared prerequisite. Detailing lands once the dispensing path is open.
Held to week 4 to respect the minimum inter-touch interval after the field visit. Consent verified for 9 of 12 targets; 3 excluded.
Routed to the firewalled scientific track. Not sequenced against commercial claims and not visible in commercial views.
Two brands claimed this account in the same window. Enterprise tier resolved in favour of Velaxan, which carries an active fulfilment dependency. Arvexa claim returns to the queue next cycle.
Deprioritised under non-response decay — two prior invitations unopened and no attendance in 12 months. Capacity ceiling reached.
